what.en: Item 4.1: the statutory agent's physical street address in Arizona, not a P.O. box. The agent must be an Arizona resident or an entity authorized to do business in Arizona.
what.zh: 第4.1项：法定代理人在亚利桑那州的实际街道地址，不可用邮政信箱。代理人须为亚利桑那州居民，或获准在该州经营的实体。

ifNone.en: Hire a commercial statutory agent in Arizona and use its street address. The agent must also sign the Statutory Agent Acceptance (form M002), filed with the articles.
ifNone.zh: 在亚利桑那州聘请商业法定代理人，填写其街道地址。代理人还须签署法定代理人接受书（M002 表），与章程一并提交。

confirmations.quote: physical or street address (not a P.O. Box) in Arizona of the statutory agent
must have a permanent, full-time physical or street address in the State of Arizona
The name and street and mailing addresses in this state of the company's statutory agent.
must have a place of business or residence in this state
A statutory agent is a person or business that has a physical address in Arizona.

what.en: Item 4.2: the statutory agent's mailing address, which must be in Arizona; a P.O. box or personal mailbox is fine. Commission notices go here. Tick the box if it is the same as the street address.
what.zh: 第4.2项：法定代理人的邮寄地址，必须在亚利桑那州；可用邮政信箱或私人信箱。州公司委员会的通知寄到此处。如与街道地址相同，勾选对应方框。

ifNone.en: Use the commercial statutory agent's Arizona mailing address, or tick 'same as street address'.
ifNone.zh: 填写所聘商业法定代理人在亚利桑那州的邮寄地址，或勾选“与街道地址相同”。

confirmations.quote: mailing address in Arizona of the existing statutory agent (can be a P.O. Box):
separate mailing address, which can be a P.O. Box or a personal mail box.
The name and street and mailing addresses in this state of the company's statutory agent.

what.en: Item 5: the LLC's principal address. It need not be in Arizona and may be anywhere, abroad included (5.2 has a country box); a P.O. box is allowed. Answer Yes in 5.1 if it is the statutory agent's street address. It is public online.
what.zh: 第5项：LLC 的主要地址。不必在亚利桑那州，可在任何地方，包括境外（5.2 设有国家栏）；可用邮政信箱。如与法定代理人街道地址相同，5.1 选“是”。该地址会在网上公开。

ifNone.en: Use the company's head office address, including one abroad, or the statutory agent's street address if the agent allows it.
ifNone.zh: 填写公司总部地址（境外亦可），或在代理人同意的情况下使用其街道地址。

confirmations.quote: is not required to be an Arizona address and it can be the same as the statutory agent’s street address.
If you have an LLC, the statutes allow your Principal Address to be anywhere.
The principal address, which may be the same as the mailing address of the company's statutory agent.

notes: Form L010 (Rev 10/2020), instructions L010i (Rev. 7/2021), form L020 (Rev 6/2020), the ACC Business Services FAQs and A.R.S. 29-3115 and 29-3201. The rule list has no 'in-state, any address' value, so agent_mailing uses in_state_street with poBox 'allowed': it must be an Arizona address but a P.O. box is fine. L010i says the in-Arizona mailing requirement applies when the agent is an individual, while the form and A.R.S. 29-3201(B)(3) require an Arizona mailing address for every agent; follow the stricter form. The FAQ also suggests a P.O. Box for an internet business's principal address.
